title: The Indoor Pasture
note: With the caverns open, miners are digging a pasture into the soil under the hills. Cave grass will grow there, and the herd moves indoors, out of the rain and away from ambushes.

title: Nest Boxes for the Indoor Pasture
note: Nest boxes go up against the walls of the new indoor pasture, about one for every three hens.

title: One Public Tavern
note: The fort's first tavern now welcomes travellers. Every other hall stays members-only.

title: Faces for the Herald
note: The Herald now prints a proper portrait of whoever is on camera.

title: Wagon Road to the Depot
note: Caravans can't bring wagons to our depot, so they arrive light. The engineers are studying the problem.

title: Goods the Mountainhomes Want
note: Make what the liaison asks for before the next caravan, and sign the trade agreements.
